decisionsTitle: An Administrator corrects any answer a participant typed; the address, the consents and the declaration stay the person's
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-02.** First: «Vreau să pot „curăța” și să debifez cei care au bifat că sunt membri Brașov Runners dar nu sunt.» Then, told the design had a «Curăță» button: «Nu vreau să se numească „curăță”, dar practic vreau să pot modifica sau suprascrie orice dată introdusă de utilizator.» So the feature is the general one — an Administrator corrects or overwrites any answer a participant typed — with the member tick as one of those answers, and a helper that finds the false member ticks in one go under a plain descriptive name.

**What existed.** §67's registration page edited the name only («Corectează numele», `correctRegisteredName`, audit `registration.name_corrected`: «Se poate corecta doar numele. Adresa de e-mail este identitatea participantului și nu se schimbă de aici»), and staff could withdraw a consent, never give one (§322, §558). Everything else the person typed — a mistyped birth date, a phone missing a digit, a city, a false «Sunt membru» — could only be fixed by cancelling and registering again.

### The decision

**One verb.** `service.ts#editRegistrationAnswersByStaff(db, actor, registrationId, changes, now)`, wrapped by `admin-service.ts#editRegistrationAnswers` and the action `editRegistrationAnswersAction`; Administrator-only (`canManageRegistrations`), asserted by the action, the wrapper and the service (BR-REQ-060-01). §67's name correction is a case of it, not a second verb: `correctRegisteredName` and its form are gone.

**The allowlist is every answer the person typed** (`registrations/answers.ts#EDITABLE_ANSWERS`, read off `fields.ts`): first name and last name, the list name, the birth date, the sex, the citizenship, the country of residence, the city, the phone, the emergency contact's name and phone, the guardian, the member tick and the club, the Strava link and the Instagram username, the T-shirt size. Each value meets the form's own Zod rule (`fields.ts#answerRules`, picked from the form's schema, so a corrected phone is E.164 and a corrected username loses its `@` exactly as on the form); a phone may be typed as the club writes it — a Romanian national number with its leading zero, or the international form with `+` or `00` — composed as the form composes it. The form's cross-field rules hold on the row as it would be: the emergency contact is somebody else (§228), refused with §231's own `emergencySame` marker so the page says the number is the participant's, not that it is invalid; a minor has a guardian (§108) and no socials (§323); the event's minimum age on the race day (§321). **The socials are judged against the day the row was written, as the minors' sweep judges them** (found in review): the retention step `minor-socials` clears the Strava link, the username and the tick of every row written before the eighteenth birthday (`createdAt` before `birthDate` + 18 years) and scrubs them from the trail, so a correction that gave such a row socials — the person an adult today — would vanish at the next maintenance run with nobody told. `planAnswerEdit` takes the row's `createdAt` and refuses it with its own marker, `MINOR_AT_REGISTRATION`, and its own sentence («Strava și Instagram nu s-au salvat: persoana era minoră la înscriere, iar curățenia de întreținere le-ar șterge. Lasă-le goale.»); a minor today is refused by the rule of today, and clearing the socials is always allowed. When only the birth date moved — no social posted — the refusal names the birth date instead, the box that moved (found in review): «Data nașterii nu s-a salvat: persoana ar fi fost minoră la înscriere; golește întâi Strava și Instagram.» Which sentence a marker gets is one pure function, `answers.ts#answersRefusalCode`, the action's only map. Carried with the answers as the form carries them: the name of record is composed from the two names (BR-REQ-031-04 criterion 6) with its key and §389's rule — a name another runner on the same address carries is refused — and the list name follows it only when it was the derived one; the tick writes the club's own name (§215) and, cleared, blanks the club only when it still holds that name, while a club typed with the tick on is refused; the socials-on-the-list tick goes when both socials are cleared, a tick about nothing; the T-shirt is kept only where the event gives one. A key outside the allowlist is refused by name (VALIDATION_ERROR naming it), never ignored; an empty change and a change that changes nothing are refused (`ANSWERS_UNCHANGED`).

**Three kinds stay the person's, and the screen says why, one line each:** the **address** — the registration's identity (§67, `AGENTS.md` §10.4): «Adresa de email e identitatea înscrierii: pentru o adresă greșită, anulează și adaugă din nou»; the **consents** — the health note and its consent, the public list, the socials beside the name, the offers and benefits, the results: «Consimțămintele le dă doar persoana — tu le poți doar retrage, cu butonul lor»; the **declaration** and its statements — fitness, the race's conditions, the terms, the signature: «Declarația o semnează doar persoana; odată semnată, și părintele sau tutorele numit în ea rămâne cel care a semnat.» **The guardian, once a declaration is signed, is the declaration's** (found in review): the signed text and its PDF read the declarant, the identity-document lines and the minor's second signature from the registration's `guardian_name` (`signed-declaration.ts`), so a corrected or cleared guardian would rewrite who the signed declaration says signed it — while the typed signature and the stored text hash are the old text's. Under any `declaration_acceptances` row, online or paper, `guardianName` is refused (`GUARDIAN_SIGNED` marker, «Părintele sau tutorele nu s-a schimbat: declarația semnată îl numește pe cel care a semnat-o.»), and the page shows the box greyed with «Declarația e semnată și îl numește: nu se schimbă de aici.» and no `was.` twin. Before a declaration it is an answer like the others — **and only a minor's** (found in review): the form keeps `guardianName` only for a minor on the day of registering (`submitRegistration`), and everywhere else a guardian on the row means «a minor» — the declarant the signed text names (`domain/signature-name.ts`), the minor's second signature (§330), the declaration's rendering — so a guardian left on an adult's row would change who has to sign. `planAnswerEdit` judges it as the form does, against the day the row was written: a guardian typed on a row that would not be a minor's is refused with its own marker, `GUARDIAN_ADULT`, and sentence («Părintele sau tutorele nu s-a salvat: persoana nu era minoră la înscriere. Doar înscrierea unui minor numește un părinte sau tutore.»); a birth date corrected to an adult's **clears** the guardian, audited like any other column (`{ field: "guardianName", from, to: null }`) — chosen over refusing until the box is emptied, because the form itself never keeps one for an adult and the success toast names the field; under a signed declaration the guardian is the declaration's, so a birth date corrected to an adult's on a signed minor's row is refused on the birth date (`GUARDIAN_SIGNED` and `GUARDIAN_ADULT` beside it, its own sentence: «Data nașterii nu s-a salvat: persoana ar fi fost majoră la înscriere, iar declarația e semnată de părintele sau tutorele pe care îl numește, care nu se mai poate scoate.») — found in review: keeping the guardian would leave an adult's row holding one, the shape the form refuses, and clearing them would rewrite who signed. **Owed on the same day it is allowed** (found in review): the requirement was judged on today and the allowance on the day the row was written, so a row written while the person was a minor — an adult today — could be corrected to no guardian at all, the «a minor without a guardian» shape the form never writes (`fields.ts` asks a guardian of whoever is a minor at submission). Both now read the one day the row was written: such a row cannot have its guardian cleared, an adult's row corrected to a birth date that was a minor's when written needs a guardian in the same press, and under a signed declaration that date is refused on the birth date with `GUARDIAN_SIGNED`. On the page the guardian's box is the public form's own `GuardianForMinor`, judged against the day the row was written (its new `minorOn`): open for a minor's row or a row that holds a guardian (so a guardian a corrected date will clear is in view), opened in the browser once the birth-date box makes the row a minor's, always there without JavaScript; its help says «Doar pentru cine era minor la înscriere, și atunci obligatoriu. O dată a nașterii corectată la a unui major îl șterge.» A birth date corrected to a minor's on a row an adult signed is refused on the birth date, with `GUARDIAN_SIGNED` and its own sentence («Data nașterii nu s-a salvat: ar face din persoană un minor, iar declarația e semnată fără părinte sau tutore, care nu se mai poate adăuga.»), since no guardian can be added under the signature — never by pointing at the greyed guardian box, which cannot be filled (found in review). Reading the declarant from the acceptance instead was refused: the acceptance keeps the typed signature, not the declarant as registered, and the rule is simpler where the row and the signed text cannot disagree. Nor anything that is not an answer: the state, the place, the number, `kind`, the language.

**What it writes.** Under the event's lock (the lock §389's name rule needs), the row read again under it; only the changed columns, in one statement; **one audit row per changed column**, `registration.answer_corrected` `{ field, from, to }`, plus §67's `registration.name_corrected` `{ from, to }` when the name of record follows — one row per field rather than one row with three lists, so the trail reads «Răspuns corectat: Telefon · {from, to}» line by line. No email, no state, no place, no number: the allocator never reads an answer (§48). The person sees the corrected answers on their own page («Înscrierile mele», the manage link) and in later emails, which read the row. Any status; an erased row is NOT_FOUND; a TEST row is corrected like a real one (§30). The values are the person's data, so they go with it: the erase and the retention sweep remove `from` and `to` as they already did a rename's (`scrubRegistrationsFromAudit`); the emergency contact's seven days after the event with the contact itself (`jobs/retention.ts`, step `identity-and-health`); and a corrected Strava link, Instagram username or socials-on-the-list tick when the socials go — withdrawn by the person or by staff (`clearOptionalData`, §322) or cleared by the minors' sweep (step `minor-socials`, §323), found in review: a withdrawal the trail outlived would not be one. One helper, `audit/repository.ts#scrubCorrectedAnswerValues`, in the transaction that clears the columns, leaving which field, who and when.

**The page.** «Datele înscrierii», its own block on the registration's page — after the race-day and places blocks, beside cancel, never inside «Ziua cursei», the places, the offer or «În afara locurilor». Closed behind a plain link («Modifică datele» for the Administrator, «Arată datele» for the Organizer), because the phone and the emergency contact are among the answers: opening it is recorded like the emergency section (`readRegistrationAnswers`, audit `registration.answers_viewed`, no value), and the trail shows a corrected phone's or emergency contact's values only beside a recorded read. Open, the Administrator gets one form with every answer prefilled (the two names required only when the row has them: an older row kept only the name of record, and requiring both boxes would block every other correction until they were typed), each box beside a hidden `was.<name>` twin holding what the page rendered: only the boxes that moved become the correction, so a page opened before a colleague's save corrects only what this Administrator changed. The question names the person and the fields changed («Corectezi la {name}: {fields}…»; `ConfirmSpec.changedFields`, filled in the browser from the moved boxes; none moved, no question, the server says nothing would change). A success flashes «Date corectate: {fields}», the field names only. The Organizer reads the same answers as a list and gets no form (§289). «Corectează numele» is folded in rather than kept beside it: one form, one trail, and the name is an answer like the others. 44-pixel targets; both locales.

**The member-tick sweep: «Bife de membru fără cont de membru».** The WIP called it «Curăță»; the owner refused the word, so the name says what the list is. On the registrations list filtered to the members (the filter, or a summary pill pressed with it, §626), the Administrator's button opens a preview in place (`?memberSweep=1`, the bulk verbs' shape, §606): every ticked real registration in the list's scope — the event when the list is about one, else every event that has not started — whose canonical address matches no live members' account, each with its name, event and masked address (`an•••@example.org`), a ticked box per row (unticking it is «Lasă bifa»: chosen over a link per row so the press is one page and the dialog counts what is left; each box carries the caption «Bifat = se scoate bifa · debifat = Lasă bifa», so the control the brief names is on every row, not only in the note), the count, and a note on who counts. «Scoate bifa la cele {n}» confirms: **one transaction**, the candidates read again inside it — only a posted id still a candidate is cleared, so an account added since the preview keeps that person's tick — each row the correction above with the tick off (its own audit rows), and one summary row `registrations.member_ticks_cleared` `{ count, eventId|null }`; a toast and a banner give the count; an empty preview says «Nicio bifă de scos». The row's «Nu e membru» / «E membru» in the list's ⋮ menu is the same correction of one answer.

**Who counts as a member: every live `staff_users` account, whatever its role.** The members' zone made a member a `MEMBER` row (§524), and the colleagues who run the backoffice are members too — «only role MEMBER» would offer to untick the club's own staff. A revoked account is a deleted row, so it counts as nobody; an invited account not yet signed in counts. Compared through the versioned canonicalizer (`AGENTS.md` §10.4): each account's address through `canonicalizeEmail` against `participants.canonical_email`. A member registered on another address shows in the preview, and the note says to leave them out.

### What was refused

- **Editing the address.** It is the identity (§67, §10.4); a wrong one is a cancellation and a new registration. No verified-email edit, no participant merge.
- **Granting a consent.** Staff withdraw, never give (§322, §558); the health note stays under its consent and is not an answer here.
- **A staff-signed declaration**, or ticking the fitness, the conditions or the terms for somebody (`AGENTS.md` §10.8, §15.11).
- **A silent sweep** that unticks every non-matching address without a preview: a member on a family or work address would lose a true tick with nobody looking.
- **The Organizer correcting anything** (§289): the answers are read, recorded, and that is all.
- **The word «Curăță»**, at the owner's word; and posting the whole form as the change, which would overwrite a colleague's save from a stale page.

### Unchanged, on purpose

The public form and its rules; the identity rule (§67); consent withdrawal (§558); the allocator and every count; the exports (they read the columns); the members' zone.

### Tests

Integration `registrations/answer-corrections.test.ts` (the verb: several answers in one press, one audit row each, nothing else moves, no email; the name of record and the derived list name; clearing and required answers; the form's rules, every invalid field named, the emergency contact's own marker; a minor's guardian, socials and minimum age; the tick and the club; the locked keys refused by name; empty and unchanged refused; the Organizer and the volunteer refused; any status and a TEST row; NOT_FOUND after an erase; the manage page reads the corrected name; the erase and the retention scrub of the values; a minor CONFIRMED on a signed declaration keeps its guardian, the signed declaration still naming who signed, and the guardian corrected before any declaration; a minor's birth date on an adult's signed row refused on the birth date, and an adult's birth date on a signed minor's row refused on the birth date with the guardian kept; a guardian typed on an adult's row refused with `guardianAdult`, and a birth date corrected to an adult's clearing the guardian with its own row — on a minor's row and on a row a minor's when written whose person is an adult today; a guardian owed on the day the row was written — not cleared on a row a minor's when written whose person is an adult today, owed when an adult's row is corrected to such a date, and that date refused on the birth date under a signed declaration; the corrected socials gone from the trail on a withdrawal by the person and by staff, and on the minors' sweep; the sex and the T-shirt into their enums on a kit-shirt event, the country, the emergency contact's name, and the list name set and then cleared back to the derived one, each with its `{ field, from, to }` row — and every other correction's row checked with its full values: the birth date, the citizenship, the first and last names and the derived list name, the Strava link cleared, the emergency telephone, the guardian), `registrations/member-tick.test.ts` (the tick as one answer, who counts, the sweep and its transaction, the masked address), `registrations/member-tick-screens.test.ts` («Datele înscrierii» closed, opened with its twins and its question and the recorded read, read-only for the Organizer; the guardian's box closed on an adult's row and open on a minor's, judged on the day the row was written; the list's verbs and the preview, each row's box with its caption), and the adapted `registrations/staff-crud.test.ts` and `registrations/family.test.ts`; unit `registrations/answers.test.ts` (the allowlist, the plan, the typed phone, the emergency contact's marker, the signed declaration's guardian, a guardian only on a minor's row and cleared with an adult's birth date, refused under a signed declaration either way, a guardian owed on the same day it is allowed, no socials on a row a minor's when written, the refusal naming the birth date when only it moved, each marker's sentence in both languages, the question naming the fields changed).

### Follow-up

**«The day the row was written» is `createdAt`** — the minors' sweep (`jobs/retention.ts`, step `minor-socials`, §323) and this rule both read it. A restart of a cancelled or expired row rewrites the answers on the restart's own instant and keeps the old `createdAt`, so a row created at seventeen and restarted after the eighteenth birthday stored no guardian (the form judged the restart's day), yet a correction of its birth date by a day is refused «guardian required», and the sweep would clear socials the restart was entitled to. Found in review; the assumption predates this branch, so it is recorded rather than changed here: the follow-up is one «written at» instant that a restart sets and both the sweep and this rule read.
changelogLine: - **An Administrator corrects any answer a participant typed** — «Datele înscrierii» → «Modifică datele» on a registration's page corrects the names, birth date, phone, city, emergency contact, club, member tick and the rest, audited field by field with the old and new value, no email and no place moved; a guardian only on a minor's registration; the address, the consents and the declaration stay the person's. «Bife de membru fără cont de membru» on the members' list previews the ticked registrations whose address is no club account's and clears them in one audited press. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given an Administrator on a registration's page, when they open «Datele înscrierii» (the read recorded as `registration.answers_viewed`) and save «Modifică datele», then only the answers that changed from the allowlist — the two names (the name of record following them, refused when another runner on the address carries it), the list name, birth date, sex, citizenship, country, city, phone, emergency contact, guardian, member tick and club, socials, T-shirt — are written, each through the form's own rule and cross-field rules, with one audit row `registration.answer_corrected` `{ field, from, to }` per column (and `registration.name_corrected` for the name of record), no state, place, number or email moved; the address, any consent, the declaration's statements and any non-answer key are refused by name, the guardian is refused once a declaration acceptance exists (the signed declaration still naming who signed) and a birth date that would then need one, or would make the signed minor's row an adult's, is refused on the birth date (`guardianSigned`, with `guardianAdult` for the latter), a guardian is owed and allowed on the one day the row was written — on a row written while the person was a minor it cannot be cleared and is required when an adult's row is corrected to such a birth date, though the person is an adult today — a guardian on a row that was not a minor's when written is refused (`guardianAdult`) and a birth date corrected to an adult's before any declaration clears the guardian with its own audit row, the participant's own number as the emergency contact is refused with §231's `emergencySame` marker, a Strava link or username on a row written while the person was a minor is refused with `minorAtRegistration` (the minors' sweep's own test) — on the birth date when only the birth date moved — an empty or unchanged correction is refused, every other role is refused, the Organizer reads the answers with no form, and the participant's own page shows the corrected values; the erase, the emergency contact's seven-day retention, and a withdrawal of the socials (by the person or by staff) or the minors' socials sweep remove the corrected values from the trail; verification: integration `registrations/answer-corrections.test.ts`, `registrations/member-tick.test.ts`, `registrations/member-tick-screens.test.ts`; unit `registrations/answers.test.ts` (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the registrations list filtered to the members, when an Administrator opens «Bife de membru fără cont de membru», then it previews every ticked real registration in the list's scope (the event, or every event not started) whose canonical address matches no live `staff_users` account of any role, with name, event and masked address, each a ticked box to untick captioned «Bifat = se scoate bifa · debifat = Lasă bifa»; «Scoate bifa la cele {n}» clears, in one transaction, only the posted rows still candidates, each through the answers correction with its audit rows, plus one `registrations.member_ticks_cleared` `{ count, eventId }`; an empty preview says «Nicio bifă de scos»; every other role sees no button and is refused (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: an Administrator corrects any answer a participant typed, and clears false member ticks in one audited sweep
